headline: Dead Lands and Stonecradle Re-ignite Amid Surging Frontline Engagements
war_summary: Fresh territorial exchanges have broken out in Dead Lands over the past two hours, where renewed fighting around Callahan's Gate generated nearly one thousand combined casualties. Stonecradle has simultaneously erupted from its earlier lull, recording a sharp surge in casualty acceleration as forces clash near World's End and The Dais following multiple base contests over the last six hours. In Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy, direct base transfers have halted within the latest two-hour interval, yet sustained engagements keep attrition heavy around Frostmarch, Crow's Nest, and Lathair. Nevish Line continues to register intense localized butcher's bills with more than five hundred casualties over two hours despite the absence of shifting fortifications. By contrast, previously contested fronts in Stlican Shelf have cooled significantly following earlier movements at Thornhold, while rearward sectors and Mooring County remain quiet.
